exploit_name: Critical logic inversion in price guard allows flash-loan manipulation
description: The history check logic is inverted. For mature pools with sufficient observation history, the condition causes the function to return unprotected spot prices. For new pools, when TWAP calculation fails, the function catches the revert and returns spot prices instead of reverting (fail-open design).
attack_scenario: Attacker creates a new Uniswap V3 pool, flash-loans to manipulate its price 100x, triggers the protocol to provide liquidity at the manipulated price. The TWAP check fails due to insufficient history, the function returns the 100x spot price.
root_cause: The history check logic is inverted. For mature pools with sufficient observation history, the condition causes the function to return unprotected spot prices. For new pools, when TWAP calculation fails, the function catches the revert and returns spot prices instead of reverting (fail-open design).
fix_description: Invert the condition to revert when the pool is immature. Change fail-open to fail-closed for TWAP calculation failures.
notes: Critical loss of protocol assets via flash-loan manipulation of newly created or recently inactive pools.
